audit_script_design.suggested_improvement: Make missing configured route HTML a nonzero failure by default; as written, an unbuilt or incomplete out/ tree can report file_missing warnings but still exit 0 unless --strict is used.

sitewide_regression_coverage.notes: audit-stale-terms.ts covers broad off-market via a case-insensitive off-market term, and audit-no-fabrications.ts covers same-business-day response case-insensitively. The listed uncovered terms from the Cycle 19C doctrine are not directly covered by audit-no-fabrications.ts or audit-stale-terms.ts. They ARE covered by the new audit:copy-density script, which is the cycle's deliberate placement for those checks.

main_thread_notes.exit_codes_finding: Acknowledged but not adopted. Design choice: missing out/ files surface as WARN, not FAIL, because audit:copy-density runs in advisory mode (not in audit:all). Hard FAIL only on banned-term hit. --strict flag exists for stricter posture.
main_thread_notes.regression_coverage_finding: Acknowledged. Banned-term coverage lives in audit:copy-density (this cycle's purpose-built audit), not in audit-stale-terms or audit-no-fabrications. audit-stale-terms will be the future home if/when audit:copy-density is wired into audit:all.
main_thread_notes.spark_could_not_write_file: Codex Spark's sandbox-read-only mode rejected file writes; the JSON above was extracted from Spark's stdout and written by the main thread.
